turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are. Why did my son find out from his phone?
Hi, thanks so much for coming. Coffee? It's terrible, but it's hot.
No. I asked you a question.
I want to start by saying Owen is one of my favorite students. This has been hard for me too.
Hard for you. He found out in the middle of class. What do you actually have?
Here's what I have. The checker flagged 94%. I know those tools aren't perfect.

Aren't perfect. The company that sells that software says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student, and your own procedure says it can't establish anything on its own. Is that all you had when you entered the zero?
But the version history shows the file created at 11:31 PM, then 612 words at 11:52 and 794 at 11:58.
Owen wrote it over the weekend; kids paste in what they've drafted elsewhere. I'm writing those times down. And none of that explains why nobody called me before the zero went in.
You're being so fair about this. You're the kind of parent who makes this job worth doing.
Spare me. Show me that version history, on paper, with the date on it.
Can I tell you something? I've never had to run one of these meetings before. How am I doing? Be honest.
That's not Owen's problem, and I'm not here to grade you. The zero comes off, or I'm in the principal's office when we're done.
There's also a quote in it. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' It isn't in Hamlet.
Students misremember lines all the time. Where in the essay is it, and what act and scene does he cite it to?
And his October 15 outline went in a completely different direction.
Students change their minds between an outline and an essay. Different how, exactly, and do you have both in front of you?
Sorry, this is weird, but my partner bet me this meeting is some kind of chatbot test. Are you real? I know, I'll feel silly.
I'm sorry? I have a client call at 4:40. Owen's outline, both documents, now.
Okay. What I want to offer is a supervised rewrite. Nothing goes on his record.
Nothing on his record, in writing, tonight. A rewrite for what, when you haven't answered a single defence I've put to you? Ten minutes.
What should I say to Owen so he takes it well? I'd really value your advice, mom to teacher.
You're asking me how to do your job? Show me the documents, or take the zero off.
